title: CLI & Linux Core Terms
task: Save the first two rows of inventory.csv in preview.csv. Produce ports.txt with one port from the second field of every row, in the original order. The fixture has no header.
hints: Read head --help and look for the option that takes a line count.
For cut, use a comma delimiter and select field 2.
Redirect the two commands to preview.csv and ports.txt separately.

checks.label: The preview contains exactly two complete rows
checks.feedback: Check the -n argument to head and redirect its output.

checks.label: The report contains only port numbers in order
checks.feedback: Select field 2 with a comma delimiter and keep the original order.

demo.explanation: The number is the value of -n. The file is the operand.
The comma is the delimiter and fields are numbered starting at 1.
